title: Navigation
summary: Every screen has an address, and each tab keeps a stack.

requirements.text: Every screen, sheet and conversation has a URL, and what is on screen is decided by the URL.
Each tab keeps a stack: the tab, the pages opened from it, then any open sheets.
Opening a page pushes it onto the current tab's stack, even when the page lives under another tab, and the tab bar keeps the current tab lit.
Opening a page already on the stack pops back to it.
The tab bar and notification taps start their tab afresh with the page on top.
A back button returns to where the user came from, else to the page's usual parent, and is labelled with that place's name.
A page's path starts with its tab's path; the Diary owns every path no other tab claims.
